description: This PHP source file defines the Order controller class for handling order-related email notifications in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for sending order creation, update, and alert emails, with detailed processing of order data, addresses, products, and store information.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class for handling email notifications related to orders, including sending new order details, order status updates, and alerts.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the event before an order's history is added; determines whether to send an email notification based on order status and notification flags.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Prepares and queues an email task for a new order, including generating the order summary with addresses, products, totals, and store info.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Prepares and queues an email task reflecting order status changes and comments, used for order history updates.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Prepares and queues an alert email to notify relevant parties of an order event, typically when the order is first created.
